claim: TSMC's 2025 Sustainability Report says its EDA Alliance had cumulatively released over 3,900 process design kits, 58,000 technology files and 77 design reference flows.
evidence: "Cumulatively released over 3,900 PDK (Process Design Kit), 58,000 technology files, and 77 design reference flows" (2025 Sustainability Report, 'Six OIP Alliances' table, EDA Alliance row, p. 48)

metric.name: Process design kits released by TSMC (cumulative)
metric.population: PDKs released through TSMC OIP EDA Alliance
metric.methodology: Company statement; counting basis (cumulative releases/versions vs processes) not disclosed

notes: Supersedes the Oct 2021 figures in CLM-1472 (2,600 PDKs, 38,000 tech files). 'Cumulatively released' may count differently from 2021 'providing ... to customers'; treat the trend as indicative.

claim: TSMC's 2025 Sustainability Report says its IP Alliance had accumulated around 93,000 items in its IP portfolio and added one new IP Alliance member in 2025.
evidence: IP Alliance row: "Added one new IP Alliance member with expertise in specialty Input/Output (I/O) and ESD solutions Accumulated around 93,000 items in broad range of IP portfolio to support customer design needs" (2025 Sustainability Report, 'Six OIP Alliances' table, p. 48)

metric.name: IP items in TSMC IP Alliance portfolio
metric.population: IP portfolio items under TSMC OIP IP Alliance
metric.methodology: Company statement; whether TSMC's own IP is included not disclosed

notes: Supersedes the 'as of August 2023, 60,000+ IPs' figure in CLM-1475 (and the Oct 2021 40,000 IP titles in CLM-1472). Population may differ slightly ('items in broad range of IP portfolio' vs 'IPs from ecosystem IP alliance members').
